members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. A layer keeps its place and color across data changes, so switching datasets morphs it.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name in the legend, the direct label, the tooltip, and the data table.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color. Defaults to the chart series for the first four layers (the first in the accent), then neutral steps.

members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity, such as an ISO week.

members.name: label
members.doc: Full label for the tooltip and screen readers, such as "Week of Sep 14".

members.name: axisLabel
members.doc: Short label on the time axis. Leave it out to keep the axis quiet at that point.

members.name: values
members.doc: One value per series key. Missing values count as zero; negatives are treated as zero.

types.name: StreamgraphProps
types.doc: Use a streamgraph for how the mix of several parts changes over time, when the overall shape matters more than exact values.

members.name: series
members.doc: Layers from the centre out: the first runs through the middle of the stream, the rest alternate above and below it.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is measured, such as "Support tickets by topic". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after each value, such as "tickets".

members.name: height
members.doc: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the container.

members.name: offset
members.doc: "wiggle" minimises layer slopes for a flowing stream, "silhouette" centres the stack, "zero" stacks from a flat baseline.

members.name: hiddenSeries
members.doc: Controlled hidden layer keys. A hidden layer thins to nothing and the rest reflow.

members.name: onActiveChange
members.type: (index: number | null, seriesKey: string | null) => void
members.doc: Called as the reading moves, and with nulls when it leaves.

members.name: directLabels
members.doc: Names each layer inside its widest stretch when it is thick enough to hold the text.

members.name: categoryLabel
members.doc: Header of the first column in the screen reader table.
